👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Bharat se ek aisa whiskey brand utha hai jisne Johnny Walker, Jack Daniel’s aur Glenfiddich jaise 100–200 saal purane legends ko bhi piche chhod diya. Ye hai Indri ki kahaani — ek Indian single malt jo global stage par dhamaka kar rahi hai.

Aaj Indri India ki best-selling aur duniya ki fastest-growing whiskey ban chuki hai. Whiskey market ki sabse badi challenge ye hai ki Jack Daniel’s, Glenfiddich aur Glenlivet jaise brands ke paas ek lambi legacy, 170+ countries ki distribution, aur croreon ki marketing power hoti hai. Fir bhi Indri ne sirf 5 saalon mein market ko hila diya — 65+ international awards jeete, jisme shamil hai “Best in Show – Double Gold” at Whiskies of the World Awards 2023. Sirf ek saal mein ~600% growth aur 2024 mein 20 lakh bottles sold — ye numbers kisi bhi emerging brand ke liye extraordinary hain.

Ab sawaal yeh hai: Whiskey market mein breakthrough karna itna mushkil kyu hota hai? 200 saal purane global giants ke beech Indri ne yeh success kaise achieve ki? Unki business strategy kya thi? Aur hum is kahaani se kya seekh sakte hain? Ye sab jaanenge is episode mein.
